summary: Iteration 47 — Validated NEW Admin Proofs Viewer (visualization only). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass on /app/backend/tests/test_admin_proofs.py covering auth gate (401/403 without token), GET /api/admin/proofs?type=all|crypto|bank|mt5|partial-unlock filter integrity, limit param + 422 on out-of-range, GET /api/admin/proofs/{ptype}/{pid}/file 404 'Sin archivo asociado' for existing crypto items without proof_image, 404 'Tipo de comprobante invalido' for unknown ptype, and 404 'Comprobante no encontrado' for unknown id. Frontend Playwright end-to-end clean: /admin/proofs route loads AdminProofsPage with header 'Comprobantes Subidos', 4 KPI cards (Pago Crypto=3, Transferencia Bancaria=0, Depósito MT5=0, Desbloqueo 40%=0 — matches dev DB), Tipo select filter, Search input, Refrescar button, and grid of 3 crypto proof cards. Modal (data-testid=proof-viewer-modal) opens on card click, correctly shows fallback 'Este comprobante no tiene archivo adjunto' for has_file=false items, closes via proof-close-btn. Search filtering works (1 result for 'test.user', empty state for unmatched query). Sidebar admin nav exposes 'Comprobantes' link → /admin/proofs.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/admin.py admin_list_proofs() (lines 2583-2721, ~140 lines) repeats almost-identical aggregate→project→loop blocks 4 times — extract a small helper like _build_proof_item(row, type_meta) plus a config dict per type to remove ~80% of duplication and make adding a 5th source trivial.

MT5 branch uses {'$match': {'proof_url': {'$ne': None}}} but the other three branches do NOT filter on file presence — inconsistent: either all branches should be limited to records with a proof OR none should, so the KPI counts match what the user expects to see in the grid. Currently a crypto_payment with proof_image=null still appears (has_file=false). Decide and align.

GET /api/admin/proofs/{ptype}/{pid}/file silently does not support 'partial-unlock' type even though the listing returns those items with has_file=false. That is consistent but worth a code comment so future devs don't try to add it.
Frontend AdminProofsPage.jsx fetches with limit=300 hardcoded — for very busy installs add a 'Cargar más' / pagination control; right now the user has no way to see proofs older than the latest 300.

AdminProofsPage type-filter select uses the same labels as the KPI card titles ('Transferencias Bancarias' vs 'Transferencia Bancaria') with different pluralization — minor copy inconsistency but harmless.

Test note: 422 validation on limit>500 works, but there is no explicit validation on the `type` query param — passing type=foo silently returns an empty list rather than 422. Consider adding `Literal['all','crypto','bank','mt5','partial-unlock']` for clearer contract.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing dev DB state — 3 crypto_payments (all has_file=false because proof_image is null), 0 bank_transfer_confirmations, 0 mt5 deposits with proof_url, 0 partial_withdraw_unlocks with last_tx_hash.
